d:
Want to burn fat without the jumping? Add this 20-minute low impact Tabata workout to your weekly routine and start feeling the difference. Designed specifically for adults 50+ and beginners, this joint-friendly interval training workout gets your heart rate up and torches calories — all without leaving the ground.
What you'll get:
20 minutes of fat-burning interval training
8 rounds of low impact Tabata exercises
No jumping, no equipment needed
Perfect for adults 50+ and beginners
